'''519 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the chronological period known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. During this period, widespread [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] settlement commenced into yet-unexplored regions and the charting of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] began. This year saw the mass migration of the [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] to the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], where they had already been operating, to discover their possible connections with the extinct [[Eellayin/Legends|Eellayin]] natives.

==Events==
*All [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] leave their homeworld of [[Kallidah/Legends|Kallidah]] to mine at [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]].<ref name="de_dp">{{DB|species|polismassan|Polis Massan}}, {{DB|species|polismassan|Polis Massan}}</ref><ref name="TNEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref><ref name="enh_i9">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/CWenhancement1|text=''The Clone Wars'' Web Enhancement 1: Polis Massan}}, {{InsiderCite|90|Aliens of Episode III}}</ref>
